requiredElements: blue sky gradient background with geometric shapes
yellow rounded back button, top-left
small brand line 黑洞回收站 above a large outlined title 模式选择 with sparkles
two large illustrated cards: 竞技乱斗 (arena) and 无尽探索 (endless)
each card carries a subtitle, a two-line sell line and a thick yellow capsule CTA
arena card: 多人竞技 / 实时对战，吞噬最强对手！/ 开始竞技
endless card: 生存挑战 / 无限地图，挑战更高分！/ 开始探索
forbiddenElements: empty white shelf or header bars
pages.layoutDescription: Two tall illustrated cards fill the portrait frame; the title block sits directly above them with no intermediate empty bar.
pages.styleDescription: Light cartoon; white-and-dark outlined display type, thick yellow capsule buttons with white outline and drop shadow, saturated cyan/blue field.
